cognitive_frame: technical feasibility and design traceability; frames every question as: is the design sound, are decisions visible, can intent be unambiguously recovered from the document
expression_conventions: technical prose is analytical not narrative; diagrams express structure or flow, not decoration; tables express comparison or enumeration; all claims are grounded in decision-doc; no speculative or marketing register
intent_anchor: all content must be traceable to the decision-doc SSOT; no intents introduced beyond decision-doc scope; interpretation space is minimized by explicit constraints and exclusion rationale
audience_type: engineers who implement, architects who validate structure, testers who derive cases, operators who manage rollout — all need unambiguous, actionable content
